Hi! My name is Ford Johnson. 

I build analytics systems that help companies measure, understand, and accelerate growth. I turn messy numbers into stories that make sense (*and hopefully even make it fun*). My background spans web, marketing and product analytics.

This site is a place to share data projects, deep dives, and notes. I’m always happy to chat about data, projects, or ideas.
